vc_checking.summary: All seven current manual obligations are semantically provable from the accepted annotation and seed case_lib. The existing DLL segment rules and case-local payload lemmas discharge every spatial and pure premise; no annotation repair or new helper declaration is required.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: The linklist variable points to the public anchor, store_dll owns the complete circular DLL, and the new detached node contributes occupy_dll_node plus its payload cell.
vc_shape.pre_pure: xizi_double_link_insert_after_anchor says the anchor is either a list member or the sentinel.
vc_shape.pre_exists: store_dll and occupy_dll_node hide the DLL endpoints and the detached node's old next/prev values.
vc_shape.post_spatial: One of four concrete pre-write layouts: member with empty suffix, member with nonempty suffix, sentinel with nonempty list, or sentinel with empty list.
vc_shape.post_pure: The selected branch records the exact first-occurrence split or sentinel equality and the corresponding dispatch payload result.
vc_shape.post_exists: Instantiate endpoints, prefix/anchor/suffix values, detached links, and (for a nonempty suffix) its first node and remaining segment.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Split anchor=head. In the sentinel branch destruct nodes_dispatch_case into nil/cons and expose store_dll. In the member branch use payload_first_split__payload_insert_after to obtain prefix, anchor payload and suffix, split dllseg at that first occurrence, then destruct suffix into nil/cons.
witnesses.space_plan: Unfold store_dll and occupy_dll_node; in the member branch apply dllseg_split on the left and unfold the anchor cell. Each resulting spatial heap is exactly one target disjunct and closes by structural entailment.
witnesses.pure_plan: For sentinel branches unfold xizi_insert_after_dispatch_payload and use anchor=head. For member branches use the Z.eq_dec negative branch, the first-occurrence non-membership fact returned by payload_first_split__payload_insert_after, and construct xizi_insert_after_payload with the same prefix, anchor node and suffix.
witnesses.refinement_plan: No safeExec or refinement state occurs.
premise_discharge: Anchor case split is supplied by xizi_double_link_insert_after_anchor.
First-occurrence prefix and its non-membership fact are supplied by payload_first_split__payload_insert_after.
All endpoint values are exposed by store_dll/dllseg unfolding and dllseg_split.
witnesses.grouping_reason: This branch decomposition establishes the same DLL segment vocabulary used by all four return witnesses.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: After the four pointer writes in the empty sentinel case, the head and inserted node point to each other and the inserted payload is owned.
vc_shape.pre_pure: head=anchor, the original node list is nil, and PreH2 already states the dispatch payload relation for the singleton result.
vc_shape.post_spatial: store_dll for the singleton inserted node.
vc_shape.post_pure: The dispatch payload relation for that singleton.

witnesses.space_plan: Unfold store_dll, choose the inserted node as both first and last, and unfold the singleton dllseg followed by the empty segment.
witnesses.pure_plan: Substitute the sentinel and empty-list equalities; PreH2 is exactly the required pure relation.
premise_discharge: PreH1, PreH3-PreH6 normalize endpoints; PreH2 supplies the post relation.
witnesses.grouping_reason: It is the base case of the shared store_dll reconstruction pattern.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: The inserted node is linked between the sentinel and the old first node; the untouched suffix remains a dllseg.
vc_shape.pre_pure: head=anchor, nodes_dispatch_case is old_first::rest, and PreH2 states the dispatch result inserted::nodes_dispatch_case.

witnesses.space_plan: Substitute the nonempty node-list equation, unfold store_dll, choose inserted as first and the existing last endpoint, then unfold the first two dllseg cells and frame the remaining segment.
witnesses.pure_plan: PreH1 and PreH3 normalize the shape; PreH2 supplies the required relation without additional arithmetic.
premise_discharge: The node-list constructor shape is PreH3; the abstract result relation is PreH2.
witnesses.grouping_reason: It uses the same store_dll unfolding and endpoint instantiation as return_wit_1.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: A prefix dllseg reaches the anchor, the inserted node is linked after it, and the old successor plus rest form the trailing dllseg.
vc_shape.pre_pure: PreH3 already states the exact inserted payload sequence; PreH4 identifies a nonempty suffix.
vc_shape.post_spatial: store_dll for prefix ++ anchor :: inserted :: old_successor :: rest.
vc_shape.post_pure: The exact payload relation from PreH3.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Use the sequence already named in PreH3; after substituting PreH4 it has a concrete old-successor head.
witnesses.space_plan: Unfold store_dll, choose the existing first/last endpoints, apply dllseg_concat on the right to combine the prefix segment with anchor, inserted, successor and rest, then unfold the three explicit cells.
witnesses.pure_plan: PreH4 rewrites nodes_after; PreH3 is exactly the postcondition's pure relation.
premise_discharge: The prefix/suffix list equation is PreH1, the chosen abstract result is PreH3, and the nonempty suffix shape is PreH4.
witnesses.grouping_reason: It is the non-tail instance of the shared member-case dllseg concatenation pattern.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: A prefix dllseg reaches the anchor, the inserted node is linked to the sentinel, and the sentinel prev link points to the inserted node.
vc_shape.pre_pure: PreH3 gives the exact inserted payload result and PreH4 says the old suffix is nil.
vc_shape.post_spatial: store_dll for prefix ++ anchor :: inserted :: nil.
vc_shape.post_pure: The exact payload relation from PreH3.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Use the sequence from PreH3 and rewrite nodes_after to nil using PreH4.
witnesses.space_plan: Unfold store_dll, choose first and the inserted node as last, apply dllseg_concat to append the anchor and inserted cells to the prefix, then close the terminal empty segment at the sentinel.
witnesses.pure_plan: PreH4 normalizes the suffix and PreH3 directly supplies the abstract post relation.
premise_discharge: PreH1 identifies the original split, PreH3 supplies the result relation, and PreH4 supplies the tail case.
witnesses.grouping_reason: It is the tail instance of the same member-case dllseg concatenation pattern as return_wit_3.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: The original sentinel-owned store_dll plus the detached node resources.
vc_shape.pre_pure: No additional guard; dispatch is instantiated with anchor=head.
vc_shape.pre_exists: The post introduces dispatch type, store, data, head and nodes.
vc_shape.post_spatial: The same resources framed with a wand from any dispatch result to store_dll of inserted::original_nodes.
vc_shape.post_pure: The public anchor holds by sentinel equality; a dispatch result at anchor=head must equal inserted::nodes.
vc_shape.post_exists: Choose the incoming A, store, data, linklist_pre and nodes_sentinel_case.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Instantiate dispatch parameters identically to the sentinel-case inputs; inside the wand use the supplied result and eliminate the impossible member branch.
witnesses.space_plan: Frame the original resources into the dispatch antecedent, apply sepcon adjunction, and use the supplied store_dll result directly after the pure result equality is substituted.
witnesses.pure_plan: Unfold xizi_double_link_insert_after_anchor and select anchor=head; unfold xizi_insert_after_dispatch_payload, where the sentinel branch yields result=inserted::nodes and the member branch contradicts anchor<>head.
premise_discharge: Anchor equality is reflexive after instantiation; the dispatch disjunction itself supplies either the required equality or a contradiction.
witnesses.grouping_reason: It uses the same dispatch payload definition and store_dll result consumed by the return witnesses.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: store_dll for the member-case list plus the detached node and its payload.
vc_shape.pre_pure: The anchor address occurs in xizi_insert_after_ptrs nodes_member_case.
vc_shape.pre_exists: The post introduces dispatch parameters and a final payload result.
vc_shape.post_spatial: The same resources framed with a wand converting a dispatch result into a member payload result and store_dll.
vc_shape.post_pure: The public anchor holds by membership; spatial uniqueness establishes member<>head so a dispatch result must use the member branch.
vc_shape.post_exists: Choose the incoming A, store, data, head and node list, then reuse the dispatch result as the member result.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Instantiate dispatch parameters with the member-case inputs; obtain linklist_pre<>head_member_case from store_dll_member_not_sentinel__insert_after_payload and choose the wand's result unchanged.
witnesses.space_plan: Use the existing spatial lemma to derive the pure non-sentinel fact without consuming store_dll, frame the resources, apply sepcon adjunction, and reuse the store_dll supplied by the dispatch antecedent.
witnesses.pure_plan: Select the membership branch of xizi_double_link_insert_after_anchor. Unfold dispatch payload; the sentinel branch contradicts member<>head and the member branch is exactly xizi_insert_after_payload.
premise_discharge: Membership is the VC's pure precondition; the existing store_dll helper derives member<>head from that membership and the current store_dll resource.
witnesses.grouping_reason: It closes the same dispatch/member distinction introduced by entail_wit_1 and consumed by return_wit_3/4.

analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Expose store_dll/dllseg structure, instantiate the payload sequence described by xizi_insert_after_dispatch_payload, and reconstruct or consume store_dll using the same sentinel/member split.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: Use store_dll/dllseg unfolding plus dllseg_split for the entry decomposition and dllseg_concat for member-case returns; dispatch witnesses frame the same resources through wand adjunction.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: Use anchor membership-or-sentinel, first-occurrence payload splitting, and the existing member-not-sentinel lemma; no arithmetic facts are required.
analysis_groups.shared_refinement_plan: No witness contains refinement or safeExec state.
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: All seven obligations are from one function, use the same DLL model and payload relation, and can be handled sequentially by one worker; seven is within the controller limit of twelve.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Reuse the established proof structure with Import DLL and unqualified DLL names: first prove the four-way entry decomposition by sentinel/member and nil/cons splits; then reconstruct store_dll for the four return cases; finally discharge the sentinel/member dispatch wands. Use payload_first_split__payload_insert_after, dllseg_split, dllseg_concat, and store_dll_member_not_sentinel__insert_after_payload. No generated statement or seed declaration needs modification.

space_plan.entry: Unfold store_dll and occupy_dll_node; split the member dllseg at the first anchor occurrence.
space_plan.returns: Unfold store_dll and rebuild the circular list, using dllseg_concat for the two member cases.
space_plan.dispatch: Frame the existing resources and use sepcon adjunction to consume the dispatch result.

pure_plan.entry: Construct sentinel or first-occurrence payload relations from the anchor case split.
pure_plan.returns: Reuse the generated PreH payload relation after substituting the branch list equation.
pure_plan.dispatch: Eliminate the impossible dispatch branch using anchor equality or member<>head.

premise_discharge.payload_split: payload_first_split__payload_insert_after from the entry membership hypothesis
premise_discharge.segment_endpoints: store_dll/dllseg existential structure and branch equalities

proof_groups.grouping_reason: The witnesses belong to one function and one model, share the same payload and segment facts, and total 7 <= max_witnesses_per_group 12. Keeping them together minimizes worker spawns and lets one worker carry the entry split directly into the return and dispatch proof scripts.
